cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Description
cl.x: SikaTile®-305 Master Lite is a hybrid light weight polymer fortified tile adheisve suitable for internal and external applications including residential pools and spas on both wall and floor substrates.

cl.x: Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (May 2026, Version 01.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Substrate Quality
cl.x: All surfaces must be installed according to manufacturer’s instructions and or relevant Australian Standard(s) and be structurally sound, dry, clean and free from movement, oil, grease, wax, sealers, curing compounds, release agents and any other loose or contaminating material. Thoroughly clean old surfaces, or new surfaces that have been treated, prior to tiling. Deeply contaminated surfaces must be prepared/abraded to a clean, sound surface. Expose at least 80% of the original substrate of painted surfaces. Substrates shall meet relevant deflection standards outlined in the relevant Australian Standards (AS3958).

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Substrate Quality > CONCRETE SUBSTRATES
s: New concrete shall be 14 days old and be left with a wood float finish.
Steel trowel finished concrete is generally acceptable if the concrete allows water penetration.
Concrete above 35MPa shall be mechanically prepared.

cl.t: Substrate quality - Cement board and sheeting
cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Substrate Quality > CEMENT BOARD AND SHEETING
cl.x: All boards and sheets must be fixed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions and specifically designed for tiling.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Substrate Quality > SCREEDS & MORTAR BEDS
cl.x: Sand cement screeds must be installed as per relevant Australian Standards and left for a minimum 24 hours prior to tiling. Screeds may need longer drying time in cold climates.

cl.t: Substrate quality - Tile on tile applications
cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Substrate Quality > TILE ON TILE APPLICATIONS
cl.x: Ensure all existing tiles are firmly fixed, loose or hollow tiles must be removed and the area repaired using a suitable Sika repair mortar. Existing tiles shall be adequately cleaned prior to the application of the primer. Existing tiles shall be primed with Sikafloor-14 Prep N Prime Impact and allowed to dry prior to tiling.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Substrate Preparation
cl.x: All surfaces except waterproofing membranes shall be primed prior to application.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Mixing
s: Measure recommended amount of clean cool potable water and slowing add the SikaTile®-305 Master Lite powder. Gradually stir the mixture untill it reaches a smooth lump free consistency (approximately 2 minutes).
Allow the mixture to stand or "slake" for 3-5 minutes then restir for an additional minute without add any aditional water.
Restiring during the adhesives pot life may be required, do not add any additional water, restir only.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Application
s: Tiles shall be fixed in accordance with Australian Standards.
Ensure the back of tiles are from dust and contaminates.
Apply the adhesive with a notched trowel to the substrate to achieve minimum coverage requirement outlined in the relevant Australian Standards.
Adhesive notches should be applied in a single direction.

Apply tiles into the wet adhesive and break the adhesive notches to fully bed the tile in the adhesive layer. Ensure adequate coverage outlined in the Australlian Standards is achieved to both substrate and the back of tiles.
Tiles 400x400 and larger shall be back buttered as per relevant Australian Standards.
Clean excess adhesive out of the grout joints while the adhesive is still wet.
Allow the adhesive to dry and set prior to grouting.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Equipment
s: Tools and equipment can be cleaned with water prior to the adhesive setting.
Adhesive that has set will require mechanical removal.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Limitations Of Use
s: Test product in an inconspicuous area first
Do not apply in temperatures above 35ºC or below 5ºC
Do not allow the adhesive to skin prior to laying the tiles. If the adhesive skins remove and dispose of it, then re-apply fresh adhesive
Not suitable for moisture sensitive stone, seek further advice from Sika technical support.
Not suitable for use for direct application over timber substrates. Apply a suitable screed or ceramic tile underlay over timber substrates.
Due to external influences efflorescence is beyond the control of the manufacturer
Setting times of the adhesive can be affected by site conditions, climate and could be faster or slower than specified.
Not suitable for applications externally above 3 meters.
Not suitable for fixing resin backed tile and stone. Prime resin back tiles with SikaFloor-14 Prep n prime prior to fixing, and refer to product information and limitations on the product data sheet
Contact Sika Australia for uses not mentioned in this document.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Further Documentation
cl.l: It is essential to plan the area to be tiled, with the inclusion of movement joints, in accordance with the relevant Australian Standard AS3958:2023 . Failure to do so may result in drummy or lifting tiles. Make sure normal building or surface movement is accommodated by installing movement joints as follows:
s: Over movement joints in the substrate
At a junction between different substrate materials
At fixtures interrupting the tile surface e.g. columns
At internal vertical corners
Around the perimeter of the tiling system
At a maximum of 4.5m centres, in a grid pattern
Movement joints should be kept free from dirt and adhesive
All movement joints can be filled with a suitable Sika sealant and suitable backing rod or backing tape
